title: Describing people: personality words
lessonNotes: Use personality adjectives to describe yourself and other people.
Keep the difference clear: funny describes a person; fun describes an activity or experience.
Use evidence in a short description: kind people help others; a hardworking person works a lot.

sections.label: Personality vocabulary
items: kind and easy to talk to
kind = caring; polite = respectful and well-mannered
nervous about talking to new people
serious = not joking much; funny = makes people laugh

sections.label: Meaning in context
sections.body: Use be + adjective to describe a person: He is friendly. She is creative. Be careful with fun and funny: The film is fun; my friend is funny.

sections.label: Listen and identify
sections.body: Use the play button to hear four short, original descriptions. Listen for the personality words, then choose the matching answer below.
lines: Maya has many friends and talks easily to new people.
Arda works carefully every day and finishes his tasks.
Lena has unusual ideas for every project.
Omar is quiet when he meets new people.

sections.label: Speaking practice
sections.prompt: Describe a friend in three sentences. Use one positive adjective, one example, and one contrast with but. Example: My friend is creative, but he is a little shy.

sections.label: Writing practice
sections.prompt: Write a short profile of an imaginary classmate. Use 4 personality adjectives and explain one adjective with an example.

quiz.prompt: Which word describes a person who has many new ideas?
quiz.explanation: Creative people have new or original ideas.

choices: My friend is fun. He tells great jokes.
My friend is funny. He tells great jokes.
My friend is funny. The party is funny.
My friend is funnily. He tells jokes.
quiz.explanation: Funny describes someone who makes people laugh.
Kind people care about and help others.
Hardworking and lazy have opposite meanings.

quiz.prompt: Which word means respectful and well-mannered?
quiz.explanation: Polite means respectful in the way you speak and act.
